description: Get time-series observations for a FRED series ID. Workhorse query for any economic indicator. Optional date range, units transformation (lin, chg, pch, log, etc.), and frequency aggregation (m, q, a).

aggregation_method.description: Aggregation method when changing frequency: 'avg', 'sum', or 'eop' (end of period).

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (default 50 for observations, 25 for catalog queries).

series_id.description: FRED series ID (e.g. 'GDP', 'UNRATE'). See https://fred.stlouisfed.org/ for the catalog.

units.description: Units transformation: 'lin' (default), 'chg' (change), 'ch1' (change YoY), 'pch' (% change), 'pc1' (% change YoY), 'log', etc.

name: fred_observations
